plugin.name: MXP_Restart_Probe
plugin.author: MUSHclient contributors
plugin.purpose: Isolated same-socket and hard-reconnect MXP state probe for upstream issue 87

muclient.script: local enabled, phase = false, 'initial' local lines, connected, disconnected, starts, stops = {}, 0, 0, 0, 0 local phase_started = os.time() local output = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 6) .. '.restart-results.txt' local function record(message) local f = assert(io.open(output, 'a')) f:write(message, '\n'); f:close() end local function check(value, message) record((value and 'PASS ' or 'FAIL ') .. message) return value end local function check_red_style(marker, message) local count = GetLinesInBufferCount() for line = count, math.max(1, count - 100), -1 do local content = GetLineInfo(line, 1) if content and content:find(marker, 1, true) then local styles = GetLineInfo(line, 11) or 0 for style = 1, styles do local styled_text = GetStyleInfo(line, style, 1) if styled_text and styled_text:find(marker, 1, true) then local foreground = GetStyleInfo(line, style, 14) record(string.format('STYLE %s line=%d style=%d foreground=%s', marker, line, style, tostring(foreground))) return check(foreground == 255, message) end end record(string.format('STYLE %s line=%d style_missing count=%d', marker, line, styles)) return check(false, message) end end record('STYLE ' .. marker .. ' line_missing') return check(false, message) end local function advance(next_phase) phase, phase_started = next_phase, os.time() end function OnPluginInstall() if WorldName() ~= 'Inline images - MXP test' or GetAlphaOption('site') ~= '127.0.0.1' or GetOption('port') ~= 18766 then return end enabled = true local f = assert(io.open(output, 'w')); f:close() check(SetOption('use_mxp', 2) == 0 and GetOption('use_mxp') == 2, 'fixture enables Always On MXP mode') record('START issue-87 restart probe') end function OnPluginConnect() if not enabled then return end connected = connected + 1 record(string.format('EVENT connected=%d mxp_active=%s', connected, tostring(GetInfo(104)))) end function OnPluginDisconnect() if not enabled then return end disconnected = disconnected + 1 record(string.format('EVENT disconnected=%d mxp_active=%s', disconnected, tostring(GetInfo(104)))) end function OnPluginMXPstart() if enabled then starts = starts + 1; record('EVENT mxp_start=' .. starts) end end function OnPluginMXPstop() if enabled then stops = stops + 1; record('EVENT mxp_stop=' .. stops) end end function OnPluginLineReceived(line) if not enabled then return true end local marker = line:match('(RESTART_[A-Z_0-9]+)') if marker then lines[marker] = {active=GetInfo(104), raw=line:find('<color', 1, true) ~= nil, text=line} record(string.format('LINE %s active=%s raw_tag=%s starts=%d stops=%d', marker, tostring(lines[marker].active), tostring(lines[marker].raw), starts, stops)) end return true end function OnPluginTick() if not enabled or phase == 'done' or phase == 'failed' then return end if os.time() - phase_started > 20 then record('FAIL timed out waiting in phase ' .. phase) advance('failed') return end if phase == 'initial' and lines.RESTART_INITIAL_1 then if not check(lines.RESTART_INITIAL_1.active and not lines.RESTART_INITIAL_1.raw, 'initial connection parses MXP color markup') then advance('failed'); return end check_red_style('RESTART_INITIAL_1', 'initial MXP marker has red foreground COLORREF 255') Send('silent') advance('silent') elseif phase == 'silent' and lines.RESTART_SERVER_SILENT then check(lines.RESTART_SERVER_SILENT.active and not lines.RESTART_SERVER_SILENT.raw, 'server ceasing markup does not itself reset client MXP state') Send('soft-no-neg') advance('soft-no-neg') elseif phase == 'soft-no-neg' and lines.RESTART_SOFT_NO_NEG then check(lines.RESTART_SOFT_NO_NEG.active and not lines.RESTART_SOFT_NO_NEG.raw, 'same-socket soft restart without renegotiation retains MXP parsing') check_red_style('RESTART_SOFT_NO_NEG', 'same-socket marker retains red foreground') Send('reoffer') advance('reoffer') elseif phase == 'reoffer' and lines.RESTART_REOFFER then local row = lines.RESTART_REOFFER record(string.format('STATE same_socket_reoffer active=%s raw_tag=%s starts=%d stops=%d', tostring(row.active), tostring(row.raw), starts, stops)) if row.active and not row.raw then record('PASS same-socket DONT then DO restores MXP parsing') elseif not row.active and row.raw then record('REPRODUCED same-socket DONT then DO leaves MXP off despite Always On') else record('FAIL reoffer produced an unexpected mixed MXP state') end check_red_style('RESTART_REOFFER', 'DONT then DO marker has red foreground COLORREF 255') Send('reoffer-will') advance('reoffer-will') elseif phase == 'reoffer-will' and lines.RESTART_REOFFER_WILL then local row = lines.RESTART_REOFFER_WILL check(row.active and not row.raw, 'same-socket DONT then WILL restores Always On MXP parsing') check_red_style('RESTART_REOFFER_WILL', 'DONT then WILL marker has red foreground COLORREF 255') check(SetOption('use_mxp', 1) == 0, 'switch to Query MXP mode') Send('query-reoffer') advance('query-reoffer') elseif phase == 'query-reoffer' and lines.RESTART_QUERY_REOFFER then local row = lines.RESTART_QUERY_REOFFER check(row.active and not row.raw, 'Query mode still enables MXP on renewed DO') check_red_style('RESTART_QUERY_REOFFER', 'Query reoffer marker has red foreground') check(SetOption('use_mxp', 3) == 0, 'switch to No MXP mode') Send('no-offer') advance('no-offer') elseif phase == 'no-offer' and lines.RESTART_NO_MXP then local row = lines.RESTART_NO_MXP check(not row.active and row.raw, 'No MXP mode refuses both DO and WILL offers') check(SetOption('use_mxp', 0) == 0, 'switch to On Command MXP mode') Send('oncommand-before') advance('oncommand-before') elseif phase == 'oncommand-before' and lines.RESTART_ONCOMMAND_BEFORE then local row = lines.RESTART_ONCOMMAND_BEFORE check(not row.active and row.raw, 'On Command mode waits for MXP subnegotiation') Send('oncommand-start') advance('oncommand-start') elseif phase == 'oncommand-start' and lines.RESTART_ONCOMMAND_STARTED then local row = lines.RESTART_ONCOMMAND_STARTED check(row.active and not row.raw, 'On Command mode enables MXP after subnegotiation') check_red_style('RESTART_ONCOMMAND_STARTED', 'On Command marker has red foreground') check(SetOption('use_mxp', 2) == 0, 'restore Always On mode before reconnect') Send('hard-close') advance('hard-close') elseif phase == 'hard-close' and disconnected > 0 then local status = Connect() record('ACTION hard reconnect status=' .. tostring(status)) advance('hard-reconnect') elseif phase == 'hard-reconnect' and lines.RESTART_INITIAL_2 then check(connected >= 2 and lines.RESTART_INITIAL_2.active and not lines.RESTART_INITIAL_2.raw, 'new socket restores MXP parsing and color markup') check_red_style('RESTART_INITIAL_2', 'hard reconnect marker has red foreground COLORREF 255') record('PASS issue-87 restart probe completed') advance('done') end end
